scheme_name: Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant For Newly Recruited Faculty Members
description:
The Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant for Newly Recruited Faculty Members is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to enhance research capabilities among newly appointed faculty in higher education institutions.

This scheme was introduced in 2014 by the Department of Science and Technology under the Ministry of Science and Technology.

The primary objective of the grant is to provide financial support to newly recruited faculty members at universities and colleges in India.

The scheme aims to foster research culture in educational institutions by enabling faculty members to undertake innovative research projects.

The grant is designed to assist faculty members in establishing their research careers and contributing to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is up to INR 25 lakhs for a duration of three years.

The grant can be utilized for various research-related expenses including equipment purchase, consumables, and travel for research purposes.

Eligible applicants must be newly recruited faculty members who have joined a recognized university or college within the last two years.

The faculty members must hold a Ph.D. degree in their respective fields to qualify for the grant.

The scheme is open to faculty members across all disciplines including science, engineering, humanities, and social sciences.

The application process for the Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant involves several steps.

First, eligible faculty members must prepare a detailed research proposal outlining their intended research work.

The proposal should include objectives, methodology, expected outcomes, and a budget breakdown.

The proposal must be submitted through the online portal designated by the Department of Science and Technology.

Applicants are required to provide supporting documents including their curriculum vitae, proof of appointment, and any relevant publications.

Once submitted, the proposals are evaluated by a committee of experts in the relevant field.

The evaluation process typically takes about three to six months.

Successful applicants are notified via email and are required to complete additional formalities before the grant is disbursed.

The grant is disbursed in installments based on the progress of the research work.

The first installment is usually released upon approval of the project and submission of necessary documents.

Subsequent installments are contingent upon the submission of progress reports and financial statements.

The timeline for application submission is generally announced annually.

The Department of Science and Technology publishes a call for proposals on its official website.

The call for proposals usually opens in the first quarter of the year.

The deadline for submission is typically set for three months after the call is announced.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Science and Technology.

The department can be contacted through its official website for any queries related to the grant.

The contact details for the Department of Science and Technology are available on their official portal.

The scheme has been instrumental in promoting research activities among young faculty members.

It has led to the establishment of several innovative research projects across various institutions.

The grant has also contributed to the publication of numerous research papers in reputed journals.

As of 2023, the scheme has supported over 500 faculty members since its inception.

The impact of this grant is evident in the increased number of research collaborations between institutions.

The scheme has also encouraged interdisciplinary research among faculty members from different fields.

The Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant is part of the larger effort by the Indian government to enhance the quality of higher education.

The initiative aligns with the National Policy on Education which emphasizes the importance of research in higher education.

The scheme is named after Dr. D.S. Kothari who was a prominent physicist and educationist in India.

Dr. Kothari played a crucial role in shaping science education and research in the country.

The grant reflects the government's commitment to fostering a robust research ecosystem in India.

In addition to financial support, the scheme also aims to build a community of researchers among newly recruited faculty.

The grant encourages faculty members to engage in capacity building and skill development activities.

The initiative is expected to have a long-term impact on the research landscape of Indian higher education.

The government continuously reviews and updates the scheme to meet the evolving needs of the academic community.

Overall, the Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant for Newly Recruited Faculty Members is a vital program that supports the growth of research in Indian higher education institutions.

It empowers young researchers to pursue their academic interests and contribute to the global body of knowledge.

The scheme has garnered positive feedback from beneficiaries who have successfully utilized the grant for their research projects.

The ongoing support from the government underscores the importance of research in driving innovation and development in the country.

This initiative is a testament to the government's recognition of the critical role that education and research play in national progress.

In conclusion, the Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant for Newly Recruited Faculty Members is a comprehensive program designed to support and enhance research capabilities among young faculty in India.
